verdict.rationale: A first-party help article titled "Use Fin AI Agent in multiple languages" shows Fin supports multilingual conversations. The pack contains only the title, though, so the story's key condition (answering in other languages from an English-only knowledge base) is not evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of cross-language answering from English-only content, a list of supported languages, detail on language detection and translation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
